findings.title: Materials' 51-point lens gap is a margin bet
findings.body: Materials sits at the 94th percentile on trailing earnings but only the 43rd on forward estimates, a 51-point gap that is the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 123 percent earnings growth, which would require a margin expansion that has no precedent in the sector's recent history.

findings.title: Real Estate's forward premium is unearned
findings.body: Real Estate trades at a 19-point forward-rich gap despite an implied 4 percent earnings decline, the only sector where analysts expect profits to fall. The forward multiple of 37.66 is being paid for growth that is projected to be negative, which makes the premium a bet on a forecast reversal rather than on fundamentals.
